title: Small-bias Fourier task
statement: A small-bias Fourier task is a pair consisting of a small-bias Fourier input and a finite set of coordinates of the dimension of its generator input.
caveat: The supplied definition of `SmallBiasFourierInput` does not define a generator input or its dimension, so the coordinate set's dimension cannot be determined from the payload.
